title: Bump to Skopeo v1.24.0, c/storage 1.64.0, c/image 5.41.0, c/common v0.69.0
body:
Bump Skopeo v1.24.0 and vendor in 

c/storage   v1.64.0
c/image     v5.41.0
c/common v0.69.0

 then bump Skopeo to the next dev version v1.25.0-dev

comments.body: @mtrmac thanks for the review/merge.  I've created the release with your note, will circle back to see if I can pull anything out of https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/releases/tag/common%2Fv0.69.0 that might be added.

@mtrmac these maybe?  any others?

* image/copy: Fix missing progress reporting for chunked layers by @simek-m in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/pull/848
* Don't fail chunked pull if a layer is being removed by @mtrmac in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/pull/906
* Install policy.json & default.yaml in /usr/share/ instead of /etc/ by @rahilarious in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/pull/989

@TomSweeneyRedHat I’m afraid we are not set up to collect container-libs release notes over time, and I can’t immediately spare the time to look over the full log.

The progress reporting is a genuine new feature, why not. The installation changes in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/pull/989 are definitely worth a release note _in container-libs_, but should not matter within the current Skopeo installation process (until something like #2173 happens).
